title: Target Is Hiring Store & Distribution Team Members
subtitle: Sales floor, cashier, fulfillment, and warehouse roles with flexible shifts and team discounts.
ctaLine: Target hires across stores and distribution centers year-round. See openings near you.
intro: Target employs team members across its stores and distribution centers, from guest-facing sales-floor and cashier roles to behind-the-scenes fulfillment and warehouse positions. Many roles are entry-level with training, so prior retail experience usually isn't required. The company is known for a starting-wage floor and a culture of internal promotion, so an entry role can grow into a lead position over time. Hiring runs year-round with additional seasonal roles opening during busy periods. Here's what's typically available and how to apply.

sections.h: What the work is really like day-to-day
sections.p: Store roles are active and guest-focused. On the sales floor you restock shelves, set up displays, and help guests find items; at the front of store you run a register and handle returns; in fulfillment you pick online orders and bring them out for drive-up pickup. Distribution-center roles are more physical, involving unloading, sorting, and moving inventory at a steady pace. Across roles, expect to be on your feet and part of a team, with training provided before you work independently.
Target offers full- and part-time schedules built around store and warehouse operating hours.
bullets: Daytime, evening, and some overnight shifts
Early-morning stocking and truck-unload shifts at many stores
Seasonal roles during busy shopping periods
Exact hours are set by each store or distribution center

sections.p: Benefits vary by role and hours, and eligibility is explained during hiring. Commonly advertised offerings include a team member discount, health coverage options for eligible employees, and education-assistance programs. Confirm what applies to a specific role on the official posting.
Starting pay varies by location and role; distribution-center and specialized roles typically pay more than entry-level store roles. Confirm the exact rate on the official posting for your area.

steps: Pick the role and your nearest store or DC
Open the official Target careers site
Apply online and complete any short assessment
